description: Individual entries for three ecological Sky Maw variants.

entries.title: Cloud Maw
entries.summary: An ethereal transparent Sky Maw feeds on elemental sky magic and subtly redirects air currents.
body: Cloud Maws blend almost perfectly with open sky, making them less physically aggressive but exceptionally difficult to detect or remove. Their feeding can alter the currents sustaining nearby travel and floating terrain.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Profile
body: The source names this ecological variant without a separate converted stat block.

entries.title: Tempest Maw
entries.summary: A large aggressive parasite consumes storms, intensifies turbulence, and releases electrical pulses while feeding.
body: Tempest Maws thrive where violent weather, magical power, and unstable currents converge. Their presence can enlarge an existing storm and transform a navigational hazard into a sustained predatory event.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Profile
body: The source names electrical and storm-feeding abilities without a separate converted stat block.

entries.title: Abyss Maw
entries.summary: The largest Sky Maw variant inhabits the boundary of the Abyss and can drain an entire ship nearly at once.
body: This rare parasite consumes both life and magical vessel power at catastrophic scale. Sailors regard an Abyss Maw sighting as a harbinger of doom rather than an ordinary infestation.
It is distinct from the amorphous [[abyssal-maw|Abyssal Maw]], despite the similar name used in surviving accounts.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Profile
body: The source describes exceptional siphoning power without a separate converted stat block.
